prompt: Vitrine site footer shown last on every museum page: wordmark and motto, the nav links again, and credits to the Art Institute of Chicago, The Met and Wikipedia for the real images and texts.
shortDesc: Site footer: put it last on EVERY page, after </main>, always as <g-site-footer></g-site-footer>. It credits the Art Institute of Chicago, The Met and Wikipedia for the images and texts, states that no art on the site is AI-generated, and repeats the nav links (Highlights, Collections, My exhibitions, Search). Needs no attributes; site-name="Vitrine" only if the header uses a different name.

props.name: site-name
props.description: Wordmark text, matching g-site-header's site-name. Default "Vitrine".

styling.tailwindClasses: grid grid-cols-1 min-[860px]:grid-cols-[2fr_1fr_2fr] gap-8 max-w-[1240px] mx-auto px-4 py-7 min-[860px]:px-8 min-[860px]:py-10 bg-[#fffdf9] border-t border-[#e0d9cd]
styling.notes: Full-bleed --paper band with a 1px --rule top border; 1240px inner grid 2fr/1fr/2fr (32px gap, 40px 32px padding) from 860px up (the same breakpoint as g-site-header), stacking to one column below it (28px 16px). Column 1: Newsreader 500 20px wordmark with an 8px oxblood pin, an italic serif motto in --soft and a short gilt hairline. Column 2: 'Visit' label and a 14px nav list (44px targets below 860px, 32px above). Column 3: 'Credits' label and 13px --soft credits with oxblood external links (new tab, rel=noopener, screen-reader hint). A hairline-ruled base row carries the year and name. Oxblood focus ring from TOKENS.
